status: provisional small-set development calibration; not a population false-accept guarantee
scoreDefinition: Best exact 80 ms offset bin ranked by deduplicated query-anchor identity; occupancy and distinct non-adjacent-bin unique-anchor margin are additional floors. Neighboring bins remain separate alternatives.
calibrationMethod: For 10 s only, preserve every baseline floor, including the raw distinct-competitor ratio. Raise the minimum-anchor floor to max(baseline minimum, maximum observed calibration-negative best-mode count + 1), and add a unique-anchor margin floor of max(baseline distinct-competitor ratio, maximum observed calibration-negative unique-anchor margin + 0.01). No floor is relaxed.
windowAggregation: Each requested window is scored separately. Exact offset bins and overlapping windows are not merged; anchor IDs deduplicate within a mode and identify support shared with competing modes.
